How does the Hashtag Generator work?

The Hashtag Generator helps you discover the best tags for your posts. Using the right keywords is essential to increase organic reach.

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.desc: Focus timer for work and study. 25-min focus blocks.
pomodoro.article:
How does the Pomodoro Timer help?

The Pomodoro Timer uses the famous technique of focusing intensely for a period (usually 25 minutes) and resting for a short time (5 minutes) to avoid mental burnout and increase productivity in studies and work.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. Click the large 'Start' button on the screen to begin the 25-minute focus session.
  2. Work intensely on your task without distractions until the counter reaches zero.
  3. When the alarm rings, the tab will automatically change to 'Short Break' (5 minutes).
  4. Use this time to stretch, drink water, and rest your mind.
  5. After 4 complete focus cycles, allow yourself a 'Long Break' of 15 minutes (selectable in the top menu).

roi-calculator.name: ROI Calculator

roi-calculator.article:
What is ROI Calculation?

The ROI Calculator (Return on Investment) is essential for investors and business owners to know the exact percentage and financial profit of a marketing campaign, stock share, or real estate purchase.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. In the 'Initial Investment' field, enter how much money you spent on the action (e.g., 1000).
  2. In the 'Total Return' field, enter how much money you received back from that action (e.g., 1500).
  3. The result panels at the bottom of the screen will update automatically.
  4. You will see your Net Profit (final value minus initial value) and the ROI Percentage.
  5. Analyze if the profit bar turned green (profit) or red (loss) to make better decisions.

discount-calculator.name: Discount Calculator
discount-calculator.desc: Quickly calculate sale prices and percentage discounts.
discount-calculator.article:
What is the Discount Calculator?

The Discount Calculator is an essential tool for consumers, sellers, and students who need to quickly calculate the final price of a product after a percentage discount, or determine what percentage discount was received on a purchase. Whether during Black Friday, e-commerce promotions, or closing a deal, knowing how to accurately calculate discounts can represent real savings.

Step-by-step how to use:

  1. In the 'Original Price' field, enter the full price of the product before the discount (e.g., 250).
  2. In the '% Discount' field, enter the percentage to be discounted (e.g., 30 for 30%).
  3. The results will be displayed instantly: the discount amount and the final price to pay.
  4. Use the reverse mode 'Calculate Percentage' to find out what the discount percentage was when comparing two prices.

Why use a discount calculator?

Doing percentage calculations in your head is error-prone. Our calculator ensures instant accuracy, preventing you from paying more than you should or selling below your desired profit margin. Ideal for comparing prices between stores and detecting fake discounts.

Base64 is an encoding format widely used by developers to transmit binary data (like images or security tokens) in readable text formats over the internet, preventing character breakage and corruption in JSON or XML.

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.desc: Everything you need to know about ZeroTools.
faq_page.meta_desc: Answers to common questions about ZeroTools — free online tools for QR codes, image compression, hashtag generation and more.
faq_page.still_desc: Send us an email and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

faqs.a: Yes, 100% free forever. No account, no credit card, no limits. ZeroTools is supported by non-intrusive display advertising.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Every tool on ZeroTools runs entirely in your browser using modern Web APIs (Canvas, WebAssembly, FileReader). Your files never leave your device — we have zero access to them.

faqs.q: Does the Background Remover work offline?
faqs.a: After the first use, the AI model (~40MB) is cached in your browser. Subsequent uses work without re-downloading the model, but a connection is still needed to load the page.

faqs.q: Can I use ZeroTools on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes! All tools are fully responsive and work on iOS and Android browsers. Some heavy tools (like Background Remover) may be slower on older devices.

faqs.q: What image formats does the compressor support?
faqs.a: The Image Compressor supports JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, and WebP inputs. You can export to JPG, PNG, or WebP.

faqs.q: How many hashtags can I generate?
faqs.a: Up to 30 hashtags per generation. You can combine category-based hashtags with your own custom keywords.

faqs.q: Why is my PDF only slightly smaller after compression?
faqs.a: Client-side PDF compression removes metadata and optimizes the file structure. If your PDF is mostly large embedded images, the reduction will be minimal. For heavy image-based PDFs, we recommend using a server-side tool.

privacy.p5: ZeroTools is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.p6: We may update this policy occasionally. Changes will be noted with a new last updated date at the top of this page.
